svg.title: 05 · New things hit the hero first, then fall back to a smaller box
svg.text: 05 · New things hit the hero first, then fall back to a smaller box
Main hall at 1080p in Demo night: a match result from 21:02 to 21:12.

g.text: Quiz at 21:15 in the lounge · The final starts at 22:15 on the main stage
Team Aurora plays the final at 22:15

svg.text: 21:02 · The result hits the hero
A new thing takes the hero first, over the rotation.

g.text: Quiz at 21:15 in the lounge · The final starts at 22:15 on the main stage

svg.text: 21:03:30 · …and steps down to the rail
After 90 s it moves to the rail with a soft glow; the hero fades back to the rotation.

g.text: Team Aurora beat Team Nova 2 – 1 · The final starts at 22:15 on the main stage

svg.text: 21:06 · Then a ticker line
Its rail time is up; it stays in the ticker until it ends. It never comes back to the hero.
Where the result is, minute by minute
Hero
Result
Rotation
Rail
Result
Run of show
Ticker
Result line
Hero time: the event's floor, 60–120 s (90 s by default).
If something waits for the hero, it takes it as the result steps down.
A crew spotlight, a story round and the emergency keep the hero
until they end; they do not step down.
One moment, one place: the rail and the ticker never repeat what the hero shows.
